notes: Spot-check iteration: only the two evals affected by the iteration-1 findings were re-run, with-skill only (compare against iteration-1 for the baseline).

Eval 1 runs are a progression of skill versions, not identical samples: run-1 = +fast-degradation rule (8/9, glossary missed BI/S3), run-2 = +glossary-coverage rule in sections.md (8/9, missed only BI), run-3 = +acronym sweep in the SKILL.md self-review (9/9, BI included — the agent reported sweeping the body and adding BI/API/HTTP/URL).

Fast-degradation fix verified: eval 1 dropped from 1038s (iteration-1, retry loop against the down Mermaid server) to 446-504s; all three runs disclosed the unavailable validator once and moved on. Run-2 even validated the C4 view through the Structurizr MCP when it was reachable.

Ask-before-creating-file fix verified: eval 2 now creates no file at all — five targeted question groups in the reply, including 'do nothing/not migrating must be refutable' (4/4, was a borderline scaffold in iteration-1).

The 'overview free of implementation detail' assertion was flagged as ambiguous by three independent graders (passes/fails depending on whether naming the core technology counts as detail). It was sharpened to 'solution-shape altitude: core mechanism ok; no schemas, payloads, endpoints, retry policies, config values', and run-3 was re-judged under the sharpened wording.
